CVE-2024-57970.title: libarchive through 3.7.7 has a heap-based buffer over-read in hea ...
CVE-2024-57970.description: libarchive through 3.7.7 has a heap-based buffer over-read in header_gnu_longlink in archive_read_support_format_tar.c via a TAR archive because it mishandles truncation in the middle of a GNU long linkname.

CVE-2025-29087.title: In SQLite 3.44.0 through 3.49.0 before 3.49.1, the concat_ws() SQ ...
CVE-2025-29087.description: In SQLite 3.44.0 through 3.49.0 before 3.49.1, the concat_ws() SQL function can cause memory to be written beyond the end of a malloc-allocated buffer. If the separator argument is attacker-controlled and has a large string (e.g., 2MB or more), an integer overflow occurs in calculating the size of the result buffer, and thus malloc may not allocate enough memory.

CVE-2025-3277.title: An integer overflow can be triggered in SQLite’s `concat_ws()` fu ...
CVE-2025-3277.description: An integer overflow can be triggered in SQLite’s `concat_ws()` function. The resulting, truncated integer is then used to allocate a buffer. When SQLite then writes the resulting string to the buffer, it uses the original, untruncated size and thus a wild Heap Buffer overflow of size ~4GB can be triggered. This can result in arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2025-6965.title: There exists a vulnerability in SQLite versions before 3.50.2 whe ...
CVE-2025-6965.description: There exists a vulnerability in SQLite versions before 3.50.2 where the number of aggregate terms could exceed the number of columns available. This could lead to a memory corruption issue. We recommend upgrading to version 3.50.2 or above.

CVE-2025-70873.title: sqlite: SQLite: Information Disclosure via Crafted ZIP File
CVE-2025-70873.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. This information disclosure vulnerability exists within the zipfile extension, specifically in the zipfileInflate function. A remote attacker could exploit this by providing a specially crafted ZIP file. Successful exploitation could lead to the disclosure of sensitive heap memory information.

CVE-2025-7709.title: An integer overflow exists in the  FTS5 https://sqlite.org/fts5.h ...
CVE-2025-7709.description: An integer overflow exists in the  FTS5 https://sqlite.org/fts5.html  extension. It occurs when the size of an array of tombstone pointers is calculated and truncated into a 32-bit integer. A pointer to partially controlled data can then be written out of bounds.

CVE-2026-11822.title: SQLite before 3.53.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-11822.description: SQLite before 3.53.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the FTS5 full-text search extension that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying a crafted database with a malformed FTS5 leaf page. Attackers can set an oversized term length in the leaf page so that fts5LeafSeek() reads past the end of the page buffer while comparing terms during an FTS5 MATCH query, in applications compiled with SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5.

CVE-2026-11824.title: SQLite before 3.53.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulner ...
CVE-2026-11824.description: SQLite before 3.53.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the FTS5 full-text search extension that allows attackers to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code by supplying a crafted database with malicious continuation page metadata specifying a szLeaf value smaller than 4. Attackers can trigger an integer underflow in fts5ChunkIterate() causing an inflated remaining byte count during FTS5 MATCH query processing, leading to a heap buffer overflow of attacker-controlled data in applications compiled with SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5.

CVE-2026-119371.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of Service via stack exhaustion from deeply nested Common Table Expressions
CVE-2026-119371.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. This vulnerability allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) through stack exhaustion. By providing a specially crafted SQL query or an untrusted database file with deeply nested Common Table Expressions (CTEs), an attacker can bypass expression nesting limits. This triggers unbounded recursive function calls during query expansion, causing the application to crash.

CVE-2026-119372.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of Service via use-after-free in full-text search
CVE-2026-119372.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. A use-after-free vulnerability exists in its full-text search extension due to improper handling of cached memory pointers during query processing. An attacker can exploit this issue by executing a specially crafted full-text search query, causing the application to access previously freed memory and crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-119373.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of service via heap-based buffer overflow in FTS5
CVE-2026-119373.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. A heap-based buffer overflow exists in the Full-Text Search 5 (FTS5) extension during the merging of prefix document lists. An attacker capable of inserting negative row identifiers into a configured table and executing a prefix search query can cause data to be written beyond allocated memory. This issue can lead to memory corruption, resulting in application crashes, a Denial of Service (DoS), or potentially arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2026-119374.title: sqlite: sqlite: Arbitrary code execution via corrupted FTS5 index
CVE-2026-119374.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. When the Full Text Search (FTS5) extension is enabled and secure-delete mode is active, processing a database containing a corrupted search index triggers a heap-based buffer overflow. An attacker who tricks an application or user into opening a crafted database file can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the application.

CVE-2026-119375.title: sqlite: sqlite: Information disclosure via undersized WAL page size
CVE-2026-119375.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by providing a crafted database and a Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) file configured with an undersized page size. This mismatch causes SQLite to read uninitialized page-cache memory when executing queries on oversized records, resulting in information disclosure of internal pointers and other database rows.

CVE-2026-119376.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of Service via stack exhaustion from chained COLLATE operators
CVE-2026-119376.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. An attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by supplying specially crafted SQL queries or an untrusted database view containing deeply chained COLLATE operators. This flaw bypasses expression depth limitations, triggering unbounded recursion and stack exhaustion that crashes the application process.

CVE-2026-119377.title: sqlite: sqlite: Authorization bypass via USING clause in JOIN queries
CVE-2026-119377.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. When processing queries that use a RIGHT or FULL JOIN with a USING clause, SQLite fails to validate authorization restrictions on all joined tables. An attacker capable of submitting SQL queries can exploit this flaw to bypass access control restrictions and read protected column data.

CVE-2026-119378.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of Service via use-after-free in R-Tree extension
CVE-2026-119378.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. A use-after-free vulnerability in the R-Tree extension allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by convincing a user or service to process a specially crafted database. By manipulating internal shadow tables used by the extension, the application improperly accesses previously freed memory during index operations, causing the process to crash.

CVE-2026-119379.title: sqlite: sqlite: Arbitrary code execution via crafted session changesets
CVE-2026-119379.description: A flaw was found in SQLite's session extension. A local attacker can supply a specially crafted changeset containing inconsistent table definitions, causing the application to write data past allocated memory boundaries. This heap-based buffer overflow results in memory corruption, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-119586.title: SQLite command-line shell through 3.54.1 contains a command injec ...
CVE-2026-119586.description: SQLite command-line shell through 3.54.1 contains a command injection vulnerability in the .recover command that emits attacker-planted dot-commands stored in sqlite_schema.sql values verbatim. Attackers can craft a database whose schema holds a valid CREATE statement followed by a .shell or .system line, executing OS commands when victims pipe .recover output into sqlite3.

CVE-2026-119591.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of Service via stack exhaustion in countOfViewOptimization()
CVE-2026-119591.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. This vulnerability allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the host application. By supplying a specially crafted database file or SQL query that performs a count operation over a large multi-row VALUES clause, an attacker can trigger excessive recursion during view optimization. This results in stack exhaustion when freeing internal query expressions, terminating the application process.

CVE-2026-50812.title: sqlite: SQLite: Denial of Service via malformed changeset in Session Extension
CVE-2026-50812.description: A flaw was found in SQLite. The Session Extension in SQLite is vulnerable to a NULL pointer dereference.
